title: Classes and objects
summary: A class is a blueprint; new makes an object from it.

say.never: A **class** is a blueprint, and an **object** is a thing built from it. `Playlist` is the blueprint for playlists. Each `new Playlist(...)` builds a separate real playlist with its own songs. Adding a song to `workout` changes only `workout`, not `study`.
say.bit: A class is the blueprint; each `new` makes a separate object with its own state.
